frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: Classical Cepheids of the OGLE collection and other surveys, at the distances Skowron et al. (2019) derived from mid-infrared period-luminosity relations; the young (roughly 20 to 400 Myr) thin disc of the Milky Way, including its warp.

appearance.note: Presentation only: colour follows each Cepheid's published age (AGE, Myr), blue for the youngest to gold for the oldest.
appearance.emphasis: Background layer: spread through the disc rather than along the arms, dimmed so the arm tracers read first.
